title: Length of Compiled Expressions
statement: For every expression $e$ and temporary-register index $k\in\mathbb N$, the compiled expression has length equal to its size. The size is the binary-digit code length for a constant, $2$ for a variable, the sum of the operand sizes plus $1$ for a binary arithmetic operation, and the operand size plus $1$ for a memory load.
